welcome.headline: One boat. One place. Everything you need to keep on top of it.

onboarding.slide-01-body: Track safety gear, certificates, and servicing for your vessel — all in one simple, dependable app built for the water.
onboarding.slide-02-body: Fishtown Co reminds you at 90, 60, 30 and 7 days before anything is due, then flags it red once it's overdue.
onboarding.slide-03-body: Keep every certificate and photo together in one place, so your vessel is ready to show an inspector at any time.

auth.terms-body-1: By registering for Fishtown Co vessel safety companion, you agree to maintain accurate records of your vessel's maritime qualifications, safety inspections, and crew certifications.
auth.terms-body-2: Compliance reminders and safety audits provide digital guidance in accordance with MCA / maritime standards.
auth.privacy-body-1: Fishtown Co respects your privacy. Seafarer data, vessel logs, and certification documents are strictly encrypted and solely accessible by your vessel master and authorized operators.
auth.privacy-body-2: We never share personal or maritime logs with third-party advertising services.
